bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository
printf 'GSERVER_CHECKOUT\n'
git branch --show-current
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short --untracked-files=normal
git log -4 --format='%h %s'
printf 'KB_PATH_STATE\n'
if mountpoint -q /mnt/f; then printf 'F_MOUNTED=YES\n'; else printf 'F_MOUNTED=NO\n'; fi
if test -d /mnt/f/G-ACE-KB; then printf 'F_KB_VISIBLE=YES\n'; else printf 'F_KB_VISIBLE=NO\n'; fi
printf 'COMPOSER_CLI_AVAILABILITY\n'
for tool in cursor-agent agent cursor; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s=AVAILABLE\n' "$tool"; fi; done
